note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: dawn sky; the gap is upper left, sun near the top-left corner; opaque

layers.name: far
layers.note: far trunks converging upward, high canopy rimming the gap

layers.name: mid
layers.note: dark mossy trunks converging upward and the near canopy; the face goes above this

layers.name: beam
layers.note: the first ray: soft warm beam from the upper left (animate: slide/opacity)

layers.name: motes
layers.note: floating dust motes in the beam (drift them slowly)
